name: The Andhra Petrochemicals Limited
about: The Andhra Petrochemicals Limited manufactures oxo-alcohols in India. The company offers 2-ethyl hexanol, normal butanol, and iso butanol, as well as normal butyraldehyde products. It serves pesticides, dyes, food, textile, fertilizer, and healthcare industries. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Tanuku, India.
